confirmed_findings.title: Production DB configuration is hard-coded and not secrets-based
Demo accounts and known credentials exist in deployable SQL/README
Login throttling, password reset, email verification and admin MFA are absent
No live checkout, payment methods, signed webhooks or reconciliation implementation
Subscription concurrency/state invariants are insufficient for payment enablement
Upload controls lack image decode/dimension/resource validation and server-independent execution isolation
Business subscription page uses provider/both audience filter
Session timeouts/proxy-aware secure-cookie handling missing; logout is GET state change
HSTS and CSP are not configured
Unbounded fetchAll listings include the three identified request pages
Fresh SQL drops tables and historical migrations are not uniformly idempotent/reversible
Audit logging is partial and log_activity suppresses failures
